train_HMR_model: train the HMR model for human mesh recovery using SMPL parameters and 2D keypoints
run_SMPLify_optimization: run SMPLify optimization to refine predicted pose and shape against 2D keypoints
compute_keypoint_loss: compute the 2D reprojection loss on predicted keypoints weighted by confidence scores
compute_3D_keypoint_loss: compute the 3D keypoint loss for examples with available 3D pose annotations
run_evaluation_test: run evaluation on a test dataset and return reconstruction error in millimeters
